clauses.reason: Amends section 4(b) of EO 12687 by replacing the date December 31, 1991 with December 31, 1992. EO 12869 section 4(e) revokes EO 12687, as amended by EO 12741 and EO 12785, effective September 30, 1993 under its section 6. The revocation names this order, so the end is 1993-09-30; the amendment had no object once the parent order was revoked. The inserted date, 1992-12-31, is disclosed as an unadopted earlier candidate.

research_rationale:
EO 12785 of December 26, 1991 (Extending the President's Education Policy Advisory Committee), read in full in the held Federal Register text (56 FR 67451, Federal Register of December 30, 1991; machine-extracted text layer). Identity: number, date and subject agree with the census register row (1991-12-26). The single sentence amends section 4(b) of EO 12687, as amended, by deleting the date December 31, 1991 and inserting December 31, 1992. Under the owner's strike-and-insert ruling (2026-10-21) the amendment continues until the parent order ends. The parent, EO 12687, was revoked by EO 12869 section 4(e) (signed 1993-09-30; 58 FR 51751, Federal Register of October 4, 1993), which revokes {Executive Order No. 12687, as amended by Executive Orders Nos.} 12741 and 12785 as a committee order whose committee had terminated or whose work was completed, and names EO 12785 expressly; section 6 makes EO 12869 effective September 30, 1993. Disclosed earlier candidate (not adopted as the end): the date December 31, 1992 that this order inserted is the committee's stated termination date, but section 4(b) of EO 12687 says the committee terminates on its date unless sooner extended, no held text states when the committee actually ceased, and a held-text search of EO 12687's number found EO 12687 itself, EO 12741, EO 12785, EO 12869 (and a held page range that overlaps it) and a U.S. Code note under 20 U.S.C. 1221 that records only the revocation by EO 12869 section 4(e), with no extension beyond 1992 recorded, so whether the committee lapsed on 1992-12-31 is not established. The end is the express revocation. The dossier has one clause (the whole order). Searches: the dossier's three machine searches (U.S. Code release point 119-121, current through 2026-10-09; eCFR point-in-time search as of 2026-10-14 with GovInfo CFR bulk XML; Federal Register executive-order catalog disposition notes and operative sentences of 17,521 saved order texts) were chosen after reading their coverage notes, which carry no scope warning. Machine hits for this order: current-law:usc 0, current-law:ecfr 0, later-events:ofr_catalog 0. The packet's by-number scan of held order texts (LOOKUPS) was read for this order; the by-number scan lists only this order's own text, and the later-events chain names EO 12869 as the revoking order through its parent-as-amended reference.
